Welcome to Tuningi Safari Lodge
One of the Top Luxury Madikwe Game Reserve Lodges
Link -->
This Lodge accommodates 16 guests in four spacious Luxury Suites and two Family Suites , all of which boast breathtaking views from a private deck built around a splash pool to cool down in on hot Summer days. The thatched lodge offers a spacious lounge and cosy dining room, a well-stocked bar and an impressive rim flow pool that overlooks an active watering hole. These general areas are interlinked by a sweeping wooden deck that leads down to the magnificent boma area, a viewing deck and the underground hide bringing you even closer to the busy waterhole.
Tuningi Safari Lodge is not only a beautiful and luxurious lodge with remarkable safari experiences, but a welcoming retreat where you are made to feel comfortable enough to feel right at home. The team of ultra professional and passionate staff are eager to please and will go to great lengths to ensure you have an outstanding safari experience leaving you with exceptional memories.
Stay at Tuningi Safari Lodge
Luxury Suites
Each beautifully appointed spacious Suite includes a comfortable lounge area. Air-conditioning and ceiling fans offer cool respite in the summer months. The spacious bathrooms have his and hers basins, a luxurious bathtub and both indoor and outdoor showers.
Explore
Family Suites
The Family Suites at Tuningi Safari Lodge offer spacious, luxury accommodations with two en-suite double bedrooms, a dining area, kitchenette, living room, and a large timber deck, all designed for comfort and convenience without sacrificing style.
Explore
-->
-->
Madikwe Game Reserve
The malaria-free Madikwe Game Reserves lies within a transition region between the Kalahari thornveld and the Lowveld bushveld, and as such, is home to a wide variety of flora and fauna. To be specific, 86 mammals, 420 bird species and 105 species of trees. Not only does the reserve boast the Big 5, but it also features a healthy population of cheetah and the endangered wild dog.
-->
Our Experiences
At Tuningi Safari Lodge, one of the top Madikwe Game Reserve lodges, guests can immerse themselves in the African wilderness through an exciting range of safari experiences. Track Africa’s iconic wildlife on morning and afternoon game drives, observe animals up close from our sunken hide, or discover the reserve’s rich birdlife with our expert guides.
-->
Stay 4 Pay 3
Safari Season Escape
Enjoy an extended escape in the Madikwe Game Reserve, where the pace of a safari invites you to slow down and truly unwind. In May and June 2026, we invite you to linger a little longer with our exclusive Stay 4 Pay 3 special.

LUXURY ACCOMMODATION
Stay at Tuningi Safari Lodge
A standout amongst Madikwe Game Reserve lodges, Tuningi Safari Lodge exudes understated luxury with two stylish room types.
Link -->
The newly refurbished Tuningi Safari Lodge’s exclusivity is emphasized by the limited number of rooms, allowing a total of only 16 guests at the Lodge at any time. Guests are accommodated in four Luxury and two Family Suites, with breathtaking views of the bush from private wrap-around decks, each with a splash pool. As one of the best Madikwe Game Reserve lodges, Tuningi has been designed in such a way that it is ideal for families, intimate groups or VIP’s in search of utter privacy.
-->
-->
Luxury Accommodation
Luxury Suites
Each beautifully appointed spacious Suite includes a comfortable lounge area. Air-conditioning and ceiling fans offer cool respite in the summer months. The spacious bathrooms have his and hers basins, a luxurious bathtub and both indoor and outdoor showers. Wifi is available in each suite.
Private wooden decks with a splash pool offer the perfect place to relax and enjoy the sights and sounds of the bush.
Check Availability
-->
Luxury Accommodation
Family Suites
Without compromising on luxury, the Family Suites are not only perfect for families looking for extra space, but offer all the same comforts and finishes of the Luxury Suites. They are made-up of two en-suite double bedrooms and a living room with an expansive timber deck from where the surrounding beauty can be appreciated. The splash pool is ideal for cooling off on hot Summer days.

Explore the Untamed Wilderness of the Madikwe Game Reserve
Our Location
In the heart of the malaria-free Madikwe Game Reserve in South Africa, there is a place where two valleys meet, an ancient Fig Tree and a tranquil waterhole mark your ‘home away from home’.
Link -->
-->
-->
Our Location
North-West Province
Situated in the Madikwe Game Reserve in South Africa, near the Botswana border, Tuningi Safari Lodge can be reached by car from Johannesburg in 4.5 hours. For those with a wider budget, and wish to experience an exhilarating fly-in safari, Federal Airlines operates scheduled 50 minute charters from OR Tambo to Madikwe Game Reserve’s excellent all weather 1500m gravel airstrip. The Lodge is a 20 minute complimentary transfer from the strip.
-->
Our Location
Madikwe Game Reserve
Madikwe Game Reserve, one of the largest game reserves in South Africa, boasts a rich diversity of vegetation ensuring a wide range of game while the topography offers ideal game viewing opportunities. Madikwe is one of few game reserves in the world that was proclaimed a wildlife reserve purely on the grounds of being the most appropriate and sustainable land area for such use.
How to Get to the Lodge

We will gladly assist with transfer arrangements through our reliable partners.

Our History
Where it all Began
Combining the wonders of the African bushveld, and the splendours of five star luxury
Link -->
Tuningi Safari Lodge – owned and built by Carl Trieloff and William Stephens in 2004 – has played a significant role in the sustainability of eco-tourism development, conservation and upliftment of the local rural communities within the Madikwe Game Reserve . They have worked on introducing investors to the Park, ensuring it is developed within the ecological framework of the reserve.
In 2012, Tuningi Safari Lodge became part of the Seasons in Africa Luxury Portfolio, when the Kruger Family bought some shares from William Stephens. Heidi and Gavin Tonkinson have been running the lodge since 2005. Their dedication and love for Tuningi is evident in all aspects of the lodge and it continues to grow from strength to strength.
Tuningi Safari Lodge is a family friendly Lodge that combines the wonders of the African bushveld, and the splendors of Five- star luxury. The daily game drives , with informed and professional game rangers, are an exciting way of getting into the bush and experiencing all that it has to offer. Whether sipping ice-cold sundowners on the lodge’s expansive viewing deck, floating in the rim-flow pool above the waterhole, or watching the animals grazing from your glass-fronted bedroom suite, Africa’s splendor promises to overwhelm you.
At Tuningi, we all have an amazing love for Africa and our surroundings. We are proud of our lodge and are extremely passionate about what we do. We are driven to go the extra mile to ensure each and every one of our guests have the most outstanding experience with us.
-->
-->
Our Team
Your Warm & Friendly Hosts at Tuningi
Under the guidance of Gavin and Heidi, our team, most of whom have been part of the Tuningi family for many many years, are warm, welcoming and attentive. They are passionate in everything they do and strive to ensure your stay in our corner of Africa is exceptional and memorable.
Explore
-->
Our Guides
With endless knowledge and enthusiasm, our professional guides will open your eyes to the wonders of this magnificent reserve.
Explore
-->
Marketing & Management
Seasons in Africa
Seasons in Africa is a premier tourism marketing and management company, comprising luxury game lodges, hotels and adventures throughout Southern Africa. Seasons in Africa manages and markets these properties to the local and International market.
Each of the properties within the Seasons group not only offers all the facilities one expects, but also warm, friendly and personalized service!
